The '''Guidon beacon''' was a staff-like device used by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to signify their claim on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. It could also be used as a weapon akin to a [[Quarterstaff/Legends|quarterstaff]] with the anchoring pike at one end being able to cause slashing injuries.

The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] may have found and used a Guidon beacon while exploring the near-deserted [[Peragus Mining Facility]].
